info.title: WANX Octop · agents
info.description:
**CentaurAI-WANX** is a smarter, self-hosted AI assistant for multiple users and agents. All routes are served under `/api`.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token:

1. Complete initial setup via `/api/setup/*` (first install only).
2. `GET /api/auth/captcha` then `POST /api/auth/login` with `username` and `password`
   (and `captcha_token` when a strong provider is active), or complete SSO with
   `/api/auth/oidc/*` or `/api/auth/oauth/*` when a provider is enabled.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on subsequent requests.

Access tokens use sliding renewal: when less than one-third of
`access_token_ttl_seconds` remains, authenticated responses may include a fresh
token in the `X-Octop-Access-Token` header. Clients should replace the stored
token when present.

Public endpoints (no login token): `/api/docs`, `/api/openapi.json`, `/api/health`,
`/api/setup/*` (wizard authorization applies), `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`,
`/api/auth/captcha`, `/api/auth/oidc/status`, `/api/auth/oidc/start`,
`/api/auth/oidc/callback`, `/api/auth/oidc/exchange`, `/api/auth/oauth/status`,
`/api/auth/oauth/start`, `/api/auth/oauth/callback`, `/api/auth/oauth/exchange`,
`/api/auth/invite/validate`,
`/api/auth/invite/redeem`, `/api/connectors/oauth/callback`,
and `/api/internal/mcp/*`.

## Agent scope

Many agent-scoped routes use the agent ID in the URL path (`/api/agents/{agent_id}/…`).
Routes first check the signed token's application scope; legacy tokens default to WANX.
Resources in another application are treated as not found, including for administrators.
Within the same application, each route applies its ownership or shared-resource access
rules. WANX administrators may bypass ownership where supported; Zhijun personal profiles,
memories and uploaded sources require the owner.

## Streaming chat

Dashboard live turns use **WebSocket** at `/api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/ws` (pass JWT as
`?token=` query param). Send `{"type":"user_turn", ...}` frames; the server replies with JSON
chunks matching the harness stream format, ending with `{"type":"done"}` or
`{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.

Text-type dashboard pushes (cron reminders, proactive care) also emit
`{"type":"dashboard_push", ...}` on `/api/notifications/ws` (same `?token=` auth) so the
SPA can show a toast even when the chat socket is not subscribed.

HITL resume still uses `POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/hitl/resume` (SSE).

## Knowledge libraries

`/api/knowledge-bases` uses the signed application scope for creation, visibility,
document access, and citations. Existing libraries remain in WANX. Zhijun libraries
are private to their owner and use local document parsers, downloaded native ONNX
embeddings and RapidOCR. Remote WANX embedding/OCR settings do not affect Zhijun;
missing local components are reported as unavailable without remote fallback.

get.description:
List agents for the dashboard.

Default ``scope=mine`` returns agents owned by the authenticated user plus
agents other users have explicitly shared.
Holders of the ``users`` permission (and admins) may pass ``scope=all``.

parameters.name: scope

schema.description: mine: agents owned by the current user; all: every agent (admin only)

get.description: Runtime state plus attached IM channels and cron jobs for the agent.

schema.title: Response Agent Status Api Agents  Agent Id  Status Get

get.summary: Preview owner understandings for explicit batch review
get.description: Private primary owner only. Read-only source and version snapshots; conflicts and invalid sources remain visible but cannot be selected.

post.summary: Confirm or reject explicitly selected understandings
post.description: At most 20 unique items. Each item revalidates its displayed version and sources under the ontology lock and has its own durable receipt. Returns individual outcomes; partial success is possible. Busy replies reject the request. No models, memory imports, field edits or automatic conflict resolution.

get.summary: Preview private owner material and version-bound consent
get.description: Owner and primary Zhijun only. Returns the first 12000 characters and the current model. Reading does not mark authorship or invoke a model.

post.summary: Mark, revoke or process a page of owner-authored material
post.description: Explicit version and model consent required. Generate processes at most 12000 characters using the configured model, saving pending proposals and progress together. Does not confirm understanding or modify documents, chats or native memory. Revocation retains history and disables dependent evidence.

post.summary: Prepare ontology candidates for owner review

schema.title: Response Edit Api Agents  Agent Id  Ontology Nodes  Node Id  Post
Response Get Facts Api Agents  Agent Id  Ontology Facts Get

put.summary: Exclude ontology entries from conversation context

schema.title: Response Preferences Api Agents  Agent Id  Ontology Context  Thread Id  Put

post.summary: Start, pause or continue an owner-led interview

get.summary: Read source-bound changes awaiting owner review

schema.title: Response Get Changes Api Agents  Agent Id  Ontology Changes Get

post.summary: Confirm a change, scoped exception or mistaken interpretation

get.summary: List owner-confirmed decisions and due reviews
get.description: Private primary owner only. Read-only; due dates use the server timezone. Does not send notifications or load legacy decision books.

post.summary: Preview a grounded decision draft from the current conversation
post.description: Reads at most 30 recent messages and sends at most 12000 characters of complete owner turns to the current model. Only exact owner-text excerpts are accepted. No draft, decision or memory is persisted; owner confirmation is a separate action.

post.summary: Confirm a decision or append an owner review
post.description: Versioned and idempotent owner operation. Keeps the original decision, prior reviews and linked-understanding snapshots. Review-derived understandings are pending and require separate confirmation. Does not send WeChat messages or edit original conversations/native memory.

put.summary: Save interaction preferences for all conversation channels
put.description: Owner's private agent only. Rejects a busy agent; returns after runtime reload. Other configuration is preserved.

delete.summary: Restore the agent's original interaction style

put.summary: Bind the owner's single private Zhijun
